headword: {勤続年数|きんぞくねんすう}
gloss: years of continuous service; length of employment

definitions.gloss: years of continuous service; length of employment
definitions.explanation: The total number of years an employee has worked continuously at the same company or organization.

examples.japanese: {勤続年数|きんぞくねんすう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧ほど⟦{退職金|たいしょくきん}→退職金：07959_taishokukin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}える→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: The longer the years of service, the higher the severance pay.

examples.japanese: {勤続年数|きんぞくねんすう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{二十年|にじゅうねん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{超|こ}えた→超える：01942_koeru⟧⟦{社員|しゃいん}→社員：03065_shain⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{表彰|ひょうしょう}→表彰：17400_hyoushou⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Employees with over twenty years of service were recognized.

examples.english: In Japan, there are still many companies with seniority-based pay systems where salary increases with years of service.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{勤続|きんぞく}→勤続：20016_kinzoku⟧ (continuous service) and ⟦{年数|ねんすう}→年数：23485_nensuu⟧ (number of years). This concept is particularly important in Japan's traditional employment system, where {勤続年数|きんぞくねんすう} directly affects salary, bonuses, retirement benefits, and promotion under the ⟦{年功序列|ねんこうじょれつ}→年功序列：12532_nenkoujoretsu⟧ (seniority-based) system.

- ⟦{平均|へいきん}→平均：03614_heikin⟧{勤続年数|きんぞくねんすう}: average years of service

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {在職期間|ざいしょくきかん}: period of employment — more formal, used in official documents
- {年功|ねんこう}: seniority, years of merit — the principle that rewards increase with length of service
- {勤務歴|きんむれき}: work history — broader, can cover multiple employers
